passages.provision_quote: Sec. 2. (a) A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student.
passages.note: Enrolled act text; the quoted provision is newly added text, not inside a [deleted: ...] fence.

rows.reasoning: Raatz sponsored HB 1608 (2023) in the Senate and voted Yea on its third reading, and the enrolled act's new chapter requires that "A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student." That is the rung requiring staff to notify parents whenever a student asks to be treated as a different gender at school: the duty is unconditional within five business days, so the rung that notifies "unless staff believe it would put the student in danger" is excluded, and the act demands notification rather than written parental permission before a chosen name or pronoun may be used.
